definitions.states: index0 median; indices1..7 original normal-run order
definitions.admission: geometry measured AND population >=4 AND zero censored samples for that channel
definitions.allChannelComparison: maximum channel residual in a bin where all three channels are measured
definitions.scalarBoundViolation: mean distance to censor interval (point target for uncensored samples); diagnostic only
definitions.legacyAbsoluteResidual: original absolute residuals; diagnostic only when censored or geometry UNMEASURED
definitions.support: coefficient-independent: every cached quadrature node is at inward depth >=12 CSS px
